subject: Mudryk speed
title: Mudryk: 37.4 km/h and a loan

lines.vo: Thirty-seven point four kilometres an hour. Mudryk's own record.
Autumn twenty twenty-two. The Shakhtar winger scores in a four-one win at Leipzig, then against Celtic.
That year he was named Ukrainian Footballer of the Year.
January twenty twenty-three: Chelsea. Seventy million euros up front. The most expensive Ukrainian footballer ever.
Now he is at Tottenham, on loan. Reunited with Roberto De Zerbi, who helped him break through at Shakhtar.
Quick on the pitch. Quick on the move. Chelsea to Tottenham in under four years.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.
